title: One FedAvg round, weighted by examples
statement_md:
Write `fedavg(models, counts)` returning one aggregated parameter vector.

- `models` is a list of equal-length float lists, one per client
- `counts[k]` is client `k`'s number of examples and weights its vote
- each output parameter is `sum(n_k * w_k) / sum(n_k)` over the clients
- raise `ValueError` when there are no clients, when the counts do not match the models, when a count is not positive, or when the model lengths differ

A 700-example client must speak seven times louder than a 100-example one.
